overview.description: The Roundhill Gold Miners WeeklyPay ETF (GDXW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in materials equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of VanEck Gold Miners ETF (NYRSE Arca: GDX). GDX tracks a market-cap-weighted index of global gold-mining firms. GDXW was launched on Oct 30, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
